verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Deel has an MCP server and OAuth2 authorization flow for connecting agents, but there is no mention of scoped or least-privilege credential issuance (e.g., granular permission scopes, role-restricted API keys, or per-agent access controls) for AI agents. Missing for 10: explicit scoped/least-privilege credential mechanism, documentation on limiting agent API access, and evidence of permission granularity beyond generic OAuth2 flow.
